description: What more could you want from a cookie? 🤭 My Peanut Butter Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies are the best. They have the perfect balance of creamy peanut butter, hearty oats, and melty chocolate in every bite. 🥜 Crisp golden edges, gooey centers, and zero chill time required - just mix, scoop, and bake. They’re cozy, comforting, and basically impossible to eat just one…especially while warm with a glass of cold milk. 🍪🥛✨ Save the #Recipe below and check out the full recipe details in my profile at taffeybakery.com 💌 1 1/3 cups (165g) all-purpose flour 1 3/4 cups (140g) rolled oats 1 tsp baking soda 3/4 tsps baking powder 1 tsp cornstarch 1 tsp cinnamon 2/3 cups (151g) unsalted butter, melted 1/3 cup (66g) white sugar 1/3 cup (66g) dark brown sugar 2/3 cups (172g) creamy peanut butter 1 large egg room temperature 1 large egg yolk room temperature 1 tbsp vanilla 3/4 cups (135g) semi-sweet chocolate chips Preheat oven to 350℉/180℃ and line two trays with parchment. Melt butter and let cool. Whisk together flour, oats, baking soda, baking powder, cornstarch, and cinnamon. Set aside. In a large bowl, whisk the butter and both sugars. Mix in peanut butter until smooth. Add egg, yolk, and vanilla; whisk until combined. Stir in dry ingredients just until a soft dough forms. Fold in chocolate chips. Scoop onto trays (2 tbsp per cookie, 6 per tray), lightly press down, and top with extra chips if desired. Bake 13–16 minutes until edges are set and centers are slightly puffy. Cool and enjoy. ☺️
transcript: These are my peanut butter oatmeal chocolate chip cookies and they combine everything you love and more into a warm gooey cookie. They're soft, perfectly chewy and come together in one bowl with no chill time required. Serve warm with a glass of cold milk and I am obsessed. They radiate me on my own burn in the kitchen
